description:
Every EU reporter ranked by value for one year -- the country-view
counterpart of `get_reporter_detail`. Returns a single-year snapshot
(every real EU Member State's quantity, value and price per flow,
ranked by value) plus a benchmark price time series: the weighted
average across whichever reporters `query.reporter` resolves to (the
whole EU by default, or narrower when `query.reporter` is itself an
aggregate -- euro area, a named group, or an ad hoc custom group), the
cross-reporter min/max envelope, and the selected reporter's own line
when `query.reporter` is a single real Member State. Use it to answer
"how does this country -- or reporter group -- compare to every other
reporter?".

compact.description: If true, condense long numeric time series (more than ~6 points -- typically monthly/quarterly windows or wide multi-partner/multi-period breakdowns) into summary statistics (first, last, min, max, mean, pct_change) instead of returning every data point. Leave false for full-fidelity series (e.g. to actually plot a chart); set true when you just need the headline trend and want to save context.

query.description: The customs-code/reporter/partner-set/period/frequency slice to query -- the same request body every tradedashboard.eu analytical endpoint takes. See its own field descriptions (customs_code, baskets, reporter, partner_set, period_start, period_end, frequency, n_top, ...) for details; exactly one of `customs_code` and `baskets` is required, everything else has a sensible default.

items.description: A nonempty tuple of pieces summed into one displayed line.

label.description: The basket's display label; default: the pieces' codes joined with '+'.

pieces.description: The pieces summed into this basket.

items.description: Every declaration under one code in one optional month window.

customs_code.description: The customs code: 2/4/6/8 digits, 'TOTAL', or a residual spelling (850440XX, 85SSS999, 85SSS).

from_month.description: Inclusive first month of the window, ISO 'YYYY-MM'; null = the request's period_start.

to_month.description: Inclusive last month of the window, ISO 'YYYY-MM'; null = the request's period_end.

baskets.description: The explicit basket form of the customs-code selection: a list of baskets, each a list of (customs_code, optional month window) pieces summed into one displayed line. Use it to clip a code to specific months or to chain successor codes (e.g. [{pieces: [{customs_code: '8524', to_month: '2006-12'}, {customs_code: '85241100', from_month: '2007-01'}]}] with a period starting before 2007). Every piece must meet the requested period. Exactly one of 'customs_code' and 'baskets' must be given.

anyOf.description: A canonical customs code, TOTAL, or a supported residual spelling.

items.description: A canonical customs code, TOTAL, or a supported residual spelling.

customs_code.description: Combined Nomenclature customs code(s), 2–8 digits, or the literal 'TOTAL' meta-aggregate (all products combined). Residual customs codes are requestable too (e.g. 850440XX, 85SSS999, 85SSS); see https://tradedashboard.eu/faq-en.html#customscode for details. Pass a list to compare codes side by side, or to aggregate them in views that fold several codes into one basket: their volumes are summed and prices volume-weighted across every tab — except the Cross-section views, which keep each code separate. Exactly one of 'customs_code' and 'baskets' must be given.

frequency.description: Resampling frequency for the series: 'month', 'quarter' or 'year'.

group_reporters.description: Explicit reporters for a custom reporter group. Each entry must be an EU Member State, EU candidate country, or Northern Ireland. When more than one is supplied the frame is aggregated into a synthetic group named after 'reporter'.

include_other.description: Bundle entities outside the top-N into a single 'Other' bucket.

include_residuals.description: Include the residual customs-code layer: residual rows in the breakdown views (subcode-compare, concentration-compare, volatility heatmap), the residual share in the response header and the related notes. False hides all of it; non-residual figures are unaffected.

lang.description: Language for translated labels in the response: one of the listed ones (the languages the metadata exists in); any other is refused.

n_top.description: Number of top entities (by volume/value) to break out individually in charts.

partner_set.description: Named partner preset, e.g. 'non-EU countries', 'EU countries', 'all countries', or a predefined partner group.

partners.description: Explicit partner-country list that overrides 'partner_set' when present.

period_end.description: Inclusive end of the analysis window, ISO month 'YYYY-MM'. Defaults to roughly three months ago — the latest period Eurostat typically has fully reported.

period_start.description: Inclusive start of the analysis window, ISO month 'YYYY-MM'.

remove_outliers.description: Drop extreme unit-price outliers before computing weighted-average prices.

reporter.description: Declaring entity: an EU Member State, an EU candidate country, Northern Ireland ('XI'), or one of the three aggregate presets ('European Union', 'Euro area', 'EU candidate countries'), or a predefined reporter group name.

year.description: Year for the (cross-sectional) snapshot. Defaults to the latest full year with data.

name: get_reporter_benchmark

anyOf.description:
POST /api/descriptive/reporter-benchmark — per-flow single-year
snapshots plus the benchmark price series.

exports.description: The export cross-section for the latest full year.

year.description: The calendar year the cross-section is pinned to.

header.description: The request's metadata: customs code, labels, units, residual share, selection and notes.

baskets.description: How each requested basket was read: its label and its pieces, each with the definitions its window meets.

items.description: How one requested basket was read: its label and its pieces.

label.description: The basket's display label (the caller's label, or the pieces' codes joined).

pieces.description: The basket's pieces, in request order.

items.description:
How one requested piece was read: the code, the window it was asked
for (a null bound = the request's), and the recorded definitions that
window meets -- facts, no interpretation.

definitions.description: The recorded definitions of the code whose window meets the piece's, oldest first: what the digits meant over the window.

items.description:
One recorded definition of a customs code: a fact of the
classification metadata, with its window and its own label.

customs_code.description: The customs code the segment defines.

label.description: The segment's own label (the definition in force during its window), in the requested language when available.

label_lang.description: The label's language (English when the requested one is not recorded for this definition).

untranslated.description: True when the label fell back to English.

valid_from.description: First day of the segment's validity window, ISO date.

valid_to.description: Last day of the window, ISO date; null for a segment still in force.

from_month.description: The window's first month, ISO 'YYYY-MM'; null = the request's period_start.

to_month.description: The window's last month, ISO 'YYYY-MM'; null = the request's period_end.

customs_code.description: The queried customs code(s), as requested (several codes joined).

data_provenance.description: Which published data produced the figures: the same selector can return different numbers after a store or classification refresh.

metadata_generation.description: The CN classification snapshot's generation; null when none is published.

frequency.description: The period grain of every series in the payload ('year' for PRODCOM).

in_eurostat_api.description: False only for letter codes and reason groups: Eurostat's API rejects them as PRODUCT values, though their trade is inside the API's parent totals. True for digit and XX codes.

levels.description: The customs code's CN description hierarchy, chapter first.

items.description:
One level of a customs code's description hierarchy, chapter first
(``ComextNomenclature.get_description_levels``, plus the synthetic
levels of residual spellings and the dated levels of former editions).

The optional flags are sparse on the wire: present when true, absent
otherwise (the shape of the nomenclature layer's raw dicts).

residual.description: True for the synthetic level of a residual spelling.

segment.description: True for a historical segment's own definition.

customs_code.description: A canonical customs code, TOTAL, or a supported residual spelling.

siblings.description: For a catch-all level, the ordinary siblings it excludes.

text.description: The level's label, in the requested language.

untranslated.description: True when the label fell back to English.

anyOf.description: The validity window of one customs-code segment (one definition).

valid_from.description: First day of the window, ISO date.

valid_to.description: Last day of the window, ISO date; null while in force.

window.description: For a level read from a dated edition (a former definition, or one of its ancestors as that edition had them): the validity window of the definition shown. Absent for current-edition levels.

notes.description: Structured notes on the selection and on the slice: whatever was combined, removed, nulled or cannot be served.

items.description:
A structured coverage note: what the data shows or lacks for this
slice (whatever was removed, nulled or cannot be served).

args.description: The note's structured facts (codes, windows, counts, shares).

basket_refs.description: Indexes of the requested baskets the note concerns; empty when it concerns the whole slice.

kind.description: Stable identifier of the note's kind, e.g. 'reporter_coverage', 'supp_coverage_gate', 'outliers_nulled'.

message.description: Fixed English text of the kind; slice-specific facts are in args.

severity.description: 'warning' when the figures are affected, 'info' otherwise.

quantity_unit.description: The unit of every 'quantity' series: net mass in tonnes.

label.description: The unit's display label in the response's language.

reporter_label.description: The reporter's display label; null for views spanning every reporter.

anyOf.description:
The residual share of a slice (``Presenter.residual_share``):
``by_level`` splits it across the level a residual sits directly under
(``chapter``/``heading``/``subheading``), ``by_kind`` across its kind
(``xx``/``letter`` -- the latter makes the 2002 letter→XX re-keying
visible in long series). One entry per present level/kind only.

additionalProperties.description:
One residual-share figure: the part of a total's value (0-1) sitting
in residual customs codes, plus the mass share when honestly
measurable. Wire counterpart of ``core.computation.comext.residuals.ResidualShareSlice``.

quantity_share.description: Share of the slice's total net mass (0-1) declared in residual customs codes. Null when net-mass coverage fails the all-or-nothing gate (see quantity_share_note) -- never a partial ratio.

quantity_share_note.description: Why quantity_share is null, when it is.

value_share.description: Share of the slice's total value (0-1) declared in residual customs codes.

by_kind.description: The share split by residual kind (xx/letter) -- makes the 2002 letter→XX re-keying visible in long series.

additionalProperties.description:
One residual-share figure: the part of a total's value (0-1) sitting
in residual customs codes, plus the mass share when honestly
measurable. Wire counterpart of ``core.computation.comext.residuals.ResidualShareSlice``.

quantity_share.description: Share of the slice's total net mass (0-1) declared in residual customs codes. Null when net-mass coverage fails the all-or-nothing gate (see quantity_share_note) -- never a partial ratio.

quantity_share_note.description: Why quantity_share is null, when it is.

value_share.description: Share of the slice's total value (0-1) declared in residual customs codes.

by_level.description: The share split by the level the residual sits directly under (chapter/heading/subheading).

quantity_share.description: Share of the slice's total net mass (0-1) declared in residual customs codes. Null when net-mass coverage fails the all-or-nothing gate (see quantity_share_note) -- never a partial ratio.

quantity_share_note.description: Why quantity_share is null, when it is.

value_share.description: Share of the slice's total value (0-1) declared in residual customs codes.

residual_share.description: The part of the slice's total that sits in residual customs codes -- present for single 2/4/6-digit requests only; None for CN8, residual spellings, TOTAL and multi-code requests, and whenever the slice holds no total value.

anyOf.description:
Why ``residual_share`` is null -- so a missing share never reads as
"no residual trade" (a measured zero is a share of 0.0, never null).

message.description: The reason in English, naming the code where relevant.

residual_share_note.description: Why residual_share is null, when it is -- so a missing share never reads as 'no residual trade'. Null whenever residual_share is present.

imports.description: The import cross-section for the latest full year.

year.description: The calendar year the cross-section is pinned to.

price_benchmark.description: The benchmark price series (aggregate average, envelope, selected reporter).

extremes.description: {envelope edge: period-aligned owner of that edge (the reporter hitting the min/max that period)}.

periods.description: The block's period axis (first day of each period); every array in this block is parallel to it.

prices.description: {line: period-aligned price series} -- the aggregate average, the min/max envelope and the selected reporter's line.

supplementary.description: True when the prices are per supplementary unit rather than per tonne.

anyOf.description:
A quantity/supplementary unit label (``supp_unit`` / ``quantity_units`` /
``quantity_unit`` in response blocks).

label.description: The unit's display label in the response's language.

supp_unit.description: The single supplementary unit the displayed series use, when one survives the coverage gate.
